pages.title: Shipping Policy
pages.bodyHtml:
Draft — to be reviewed by Wefeasto before publishing.

Where we deliver

We deliver to serviceable PIN codes across India. If we can’t deliver to your PIN code, checkout tells you before you pay.

When your order arrives

Ships in 1–2 days · delivered in 3–7 days. Orders are packed and handed to our courier partner on working days; remote areas can take a little longer.

Delivery charges

Delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more (the value of your items before any discount). Orders below ₹499 carry a delivery charge of ₹49, shown in your bag and at checkout before you pay.

Cash on Delivery

Cash on Delivery is available on orders up to ₹2,000 where our courier partner serves your PIN code, at no extra charge.

Tracking your order

Your order confirmation email has a link to follow your order. For anything else, message us on WhatsApp at +91 98452 62777 with your order number (it starts with WF-).

Damaged or missing parcels

If your parcel arrives damaged, opened or incomplete, please take a photo and tell us within 48 hours of delivery — our Refunds & Cancellations policy explains what happens next.

pages.title: Refunds & Cancellations
pages.bodyHtml:
Draft — to be reviewed by Wefeasto before publishing.

Cancelling an order

You can cancel an order until it is shipped — message us on WhatsApp at +91 98452 62777 with your order number (it starts with WF-). Prepaid orders cancelled before dispatch are refunded in full.

Returns

Our cereals are food, so we can’t take back opened packs. If something is wrong with your order — a damaged or leaking pack, a wrong or missing item, or a product past its best-before date — tell us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and a photo, and we’ll send a replacement or refund it.

How refunds are paid

Refunds for prepaid orders go back to the original payment method (UPI, card or net banking). We start the refund within 2 working days of approving it, and banks usually show it within 5–7 working days. Cash on Delivery orders are refunded to a UPI ID or bank account you share with us.

Charged but no order?

If money left your account but you didn’t receive an order confirmation, the payment is refunded to you — usually within 5–7 working days. Write to us with the payment reference if it hasn’t arrived.
